rows: bab5
During whose reign did Zechariah prophesy?
Zechariah prophesied during the reign of Darius.
ft2k
Who was Zechariah?
Zechariah was the son of Berechiah and the grandson of Iddo, and he was a prophet.
fpxm
How did Yahweh feel about the people’s fathers?
Yahweh was very angry with their fathers.
ywqh
What did Yahweh of Armies say he would do if the people would return to him?
Yahweh of Armies said that if the people would return to him, he would return to them.
x8i8
What did their fathers do when Yahweh told them to turn from their evil ways and evil deeds?
Their fathers would not hear and did not pay attention to Yahweh.
xjqt
What did Yahweh ask about the fathers and the prophets?
To make his point, Yahweh asked where the fathers were and whether the prophets live forever.
mey1
What did the people say when they repented?
The people said that Yahweh of Armies had punished them for their behavior, just as he had planned and said he would do.
ga0h
When did the word of Yahweh come to Zechariah a second time?
The word of Yahweh came to Zechariah on the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month, the month of Shebat, in the second year of Darius.
cz8o
What did Zechariah see when the word of Yahweh came to him in the night?
Zechariah saw a man riding on a red horse, standing among the myrtle trees in the deep valley. Behind him were red, reddish-brown, and white horses.
k97i
What did the angel say he would do for Zechariah?
The angel said he would show Zechariah what the horses were.
x97f
What were the horses that Zechariah saw?
The horses were those Yahweh had sent out to roam throughout the earth.
dc9e
What did the horses who roamed throughout the earth find?
The horses found all the earth sitting and at rest.
lnvy
What question did the angel of Yahweh have for Yahweh concerning Jerusalem and the cities of Judah?
The angel of Yahweh asked Yahweh how long he would show no compassion to Jerusalem and the cities of Judah.
pb79
How did Yahweh answer the angel?
Yahweh answered with good words, words of comfort.
w5ae
What did the angel tell Zechariah to proclaim about Jerusalem and Zion?
The angel told Zechariah to proclaim that Yahweh, the commander of the heavenly armies, cares very deeply about Jerusalem and Zion.
qcts
What does Yahweh say about the nations that are at ease?
Yahweh says he is very angry with the nations that feel secure, because they made the harm to his people worse.
xaeg
What did Yahweh of Armies say concerning Jerusalem and the cities of Judah?

Yahweh said he had returned to Jerusalem with mercies, that his house would be built within her, and the measuring line would be stretched out over Jerusalem. Yahweh also said his cities would once again overflow with goodness and Yahweh would again comfort Zion and once again choose Jerusalem.
ohy9
What did Zechariah see when he lifted up his eyes?
Zechariah saw four horns.
p5hm
What were the four horns that Zechariah saw?
The four horns were those who had scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.
cnte
Who were the four craftsmen that Zechariah saw and what were they going to do?
The craftsmen were coming to terrify the nations that had scattered Judah and to cast down the horns of the nations that had lifted up a horn against the land of Judah to scatter it.
hz1b
What did the prophet see when he lifted up his eyes?
He saw a man with a measuring line in his hand.
x9oe
What was the young man going to do with the measuring line in his hand?
He was going to measure Jerusalem, to determine its width and its length.
xdwp
Who came out to meet the angel who was speaking with the prophet?
Another angel came out to meet him.
jwwr
Why did the second angel say that Jerusalem would sit in the open country?
The second angel said this because of the multitudes of men and beasts that would be within her.
fp96
What did Yahweh say he would become for Jerusalem?
Yahweh said he would become a wall of fire around her and he would be the glory in her midst.
bx34
From where did Yahweh tell the people to flee?
Yahweh told them to flee from Babylon, because he had scattered them everywhere.
jdy2
What did Yahweh tell the people living in Babylon to do?
Yahweh told them to escape from Babylon.
f2yr
According to Yahweh, what happens to anyone who harms his people?
Anyone who harms them harms what is most precious to Yahweh.
mqz5
How were they supposed to know that Yahweh of Armies had sent the second angel?
They would know that Yahweh of Armies had sent him when he waved his hand over the nations that had plundered Judah and Israel, and those nations would become plunder for their own slaves.
mvbt
What did Yahweh tell the people of Zion to do?
Yahweh told them to sing and rejoice, because he was coming to live among them.
jgyb
What will happen when Yahweh comes to live among his people?
Many nations will join themselves to Yahweh, and they will become his people.
ixb1
What will Yahweh do with Judah?
Yahweh will claim Judah as his own special people in his holy land, and he will again choose Jerusalem.
kl8l
Why is all flesh told to be silent before Yahweh?
All flesh is told to be silent before Yahweh because Yahweh has been roused from out of the heavens.
nol0
Who was standing near Joshua the high priest?
Joshua was standing before the angel of Yahweh, and the adversary was standing at his right hand.
dxwx
What was the adversary doing at Joshua’s right hand?
The adversary was standing there to accuse Joshua.
fx73
What did Yahweh say to the adversary?
Yahweh rebuked the adversary and said that Yahweh had chosen Jerusalem. He also compared Joshua to a firebrand rescued from the fire.
dmzy
What was Joshua wearing as he stood before the angel?
Joshua was dressed in filthy garments.
wgpe
What happened concerning Joshua’s clothing?
The angel commanded the filthy garments to be removed from Joshua and for him to be clothed with fine clothing. A clean turban and clean garments were put on him.
qq8z
What did the angel say he had done for Joshua?
The angel said he had caused Joshua’s iniquity to pass away from him.
ij2h
What did Yahweh promise Joshua if he would walk in Yahweh’s ways and keep his charge?
Yahweh promised that Joshua would judge Yahweh’s house and keep Yahweh’s courts. Yahweh also promised to give Joshua access among those who stand before him.
mkox
What was the servant called that Yahweh was going to bring?
That servant was called the Branch.
g7om
What does Yahweh say he will do with the iniquity of that land?
Yahweh says he will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.
u83v
According to Yahweh, when will each man call his neighbor to come under his vine and his fig tree?
Yahweh says this will happen in that day.
jkfh
What did the angel do to Zechariah?
The angel who had been talking with him came back and woke him up.
uuuj
What did Zechariah see when he was roused?
Zechariah saw a gold lampstand with a bowl on top, with seven lamps and two olive trees by the bowl.
oiop
Did Zechariah understand what the things in the vision meant?
No, Zechariah told the angel who was talking with him that he did not understand the meaning of those things in the vision.
qmgu
What was the word of Yahweh to Zerubbabel about how things were going to get done?
The word of Yahweh to Zerubbabel was, “Not by might and not by power, but by my Spirit.”
ihie
What will be shouted when Zerubbabel brings out the top stone?
They will shout, “How beautiful! May God bless it!”
h3yr
How will the people know that Yahweh sent Zechariah to them?
The people will know when they see that the hands of Zerubbabel, which founded this house, complete it.
k12j
What will the people see in the hand of Zerubbabel?
The people will see the plumb line in Zerubbabel’s hand.
ftxp
What do the seven lamps mean?
The seven lamps are the eyes of Yahweh that roam over the whole earth.
lij8
What did Zechariah ask about the two olive trees beside the lampstand?
Zechariah asked what the two olive trees on the right and left of the lampstand meant.
e8c4
What did Zechariah ask?
He asked what were the two olive trees on either side of the lampstand.
j88i
What did Zechariah ask a second time?
He asked what the two olive branches beside the two gold pipes that pour out olive oil meant.
bik3
What did he ask next?
Zechariah asked about the two branches of the olives beside the pipes that pour out the oil.
q3dh
Did Zechariah know what the two olive branches meant?
No, Zechariah told the angel that he did not know what they meant.
gd88
Did Zechariah know what the branches were?
No, he did not.
g1h2
What are the two olive branches?
The two olive branches are the two people whom God has anointed to serve the Lord who rules over the whole earth.
n7y0
How big was the scroll that Zechariah saw?
The scroll was twenty cubits long and ten cubits wide.
smfd
What did the angel say the flying scroll was?
The angel said the flying scroll was the curse that goes out over the face of the whole earth.
m1bx
Who did the scroll curse?
The scroll was a curse to every thief and to everyone who swears falsely.
u5dw
What did Yahweh say the curse would do to the house of the thief and the one who swears falsely by his name?
The curse will come to their houses and remain there and consume the timber and stones of their houses.
a4fg
What did the angel tell Zechariah to do?
He told Zechariah to look up and see what is coming out.
qqpf
What did the angel say the ephah that was going out was?
The angel said the ephah was their eye in all of the earth.
u2e3
Where was the one woman sitting?
She was sitting inside the basket.
ahim
What did the angel say the woman in the ephah was?
The angel said the woman in the ephah was the wickedness.
zng4
What did the two women with wings like stork wings do with the ephah?
The two women lifted up the ephah between the earth and between the heavens.
ti7m
What did Zechariah ask the angel?
He asked where they were taking the ephah.
p7r9
Where were the women taking the ephah and for what purpose?
The women were taking the ephah to the land of Shinar to build a house for it, and when the house was ready, the ephah would be set there on its base.
ppm8
What did Zechariah see coming out from between two bronze mountains?
Zechariah saw four chariots coming out from between two bronze mountains.
v6ca
What color were the horses of each chariot?
The first chariot had red horses, the second had black horses, the third had white horses, and the fourth had spotted gray horses.
vufa
What did Zechariah ask the angel?
He asked the angel about the horses and chariots he saw.
bm9t
What did the angel say the chariots were?
The angel said the chariots were the four winds of heaven.
ukr2
Where had these four chariots been?
These four chariots had been standing before the Lord of all the earth.
f19w
Where were the three chariots with the black, the white and the spotted gray horses going?
The chariot with the black horses went out to the north country. The chariot with white horses went out to the west country. The chariot with the spotted gray horses went out to the south country.
r61x
What was the chariot with the black horses that went out to the north country going to accomplish?
That chariot with the black horses was going to appease the angel’s spirit concerning the north country.
scuu
What was Zechariah supposed to do with the offering he collected from Heldai, Tobijah, and Jedaiah?

Zechariah was told to take the offering into the house of Josiah, son of Zephaniah. Zechariah was to take the silver and gold, make crowns and set them upon the head of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest.
jo12
What did Yahweh of Armies say Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, would see?
Yahweh said Joshua would see Branch build the temple of Yahweh, raise up its splendor, and then sit and rule on his throne.
p99n
Why were crowns to be placed in the temple of Yahweh?
Crowns were to be placed in the temple of Yahweh to as memorials to Helem, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and Hen the son of Zephaniah.
mf0f
What must the people do for these prophetic events to come true?
Yahweh said these events would happen “if you truly listen to the voice of Yahweh your God!”
jw8y
Why did the people of Bethel send Sharezer, Regem- Melech, and their men?
The people of Bethel sent them to beg for Yahweh’s favor.
What did Sharezer, Melech, and their men ask the priest and the prophets?
They asked, “Should I mourn in the fifth month by means of a fast, as I have done these many years?”
k6ub
What two questions did Yahweh ask the people of the land and the priests through Zechariah concerning fasting, eating and drinking?

The first question Yahweh asked was, “When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh month for these seventy years, were you truly fasting for me?” The second question was, “And when you ate and drank, did you not eat and drink for yourselves?”
g0py
Briefly, what was the last question Yahweh asked the priests and people of the land?
In brief, Yahweh asked if these were not the same words Yahweh told the people while they still inhabited Jerusalem, the surrounding cities, the Negev, and the western foothills.
pfi3
Through Zechariah, what did Yahweh tell the people to do?
Yahweh said to judge with true justice, covenant faithfulness, and mercy. He said not to oppress the widow, the orphan, the foreigner or the poor person and not to do evil to one another.
xh89
What was the response of the people to Yahweh’s instructions?
The people refused to pay attention to Yahweh’s words.
jwkv
How did the people keep from hearing the law and words of Yahweh?
They made their heart as a rock and would not listen.
p1i5
What did Yahweh say he would do when those who formerly refused to listen to Yahweh called out to him?
Yahweh said he would not listen to them and, furthermore, he would scatter those people with a whirlwind to all the nations they had not seen.
u4cn
How does Yahweh express his passion for Zion?
Yahweh expresses his passion for Zion with great zeal and great anger.
o1eu
What will Jerusalem and the mountain of Yahweh be called when Yahweh returns to live in the midst of Jerusalem?
Jerusalem will be called “the city of faithfulness,” and the mountain of Yahweh will be called “the mountain of holiness.”
aphi
Who will again be found in the open areas of Jerusalem?
Old men and old women will sit in the open areas, and boys and girls will fill the open areas, playing there.
vofd
How will these events seem to the remnant of the people who survive, compared to how they seem to Yahweh?
These events will seem wonderful to the remnant of the people, but they will not seem wonderful to Yahweh.
mjoq
Where is Yahweh going to rescue his people from?
Yahweh is going to rescue his people from the land of the sunrise and from the land of the setting sun.
trzj
What will Yahweh do for the people he brings back to Jerusalem?
Yahweh will be their God and they will be his people; he will be faithful to them and treat them fairly.
zofm
Why did Yahweh want the people to strengthen their hands?
Yahweh wanted the people to strengthen their hands so the temple could be rebuilt.
j9tu
What happened before those days when the foundation of Yahweh’s house was laid?

Before that time, no one earned wages for their work, and no one could hire animals for work; no one was safe going about their daily activities because of enemies, and Yahweh caused everyone to fight against one another.
hew2
How did Yahweh say it would be during Zechariah’s time?

Yahweh said it would not be as in the former days. He said the seed of peace would be sown: the vine would give its fruit, the land would give its produce, and the heavens would give their dew. Yahweh would make the remnant of that people inherit all these things.
u3lv
What does Yahweh say he will do for the house of Judah and the house of Israel, who were once a curse among the nations?
Yahweh says he will save them and make them a blessing instead of a curse.
aqmk
What does Yahweh say he plans to do now, instead of harming the people as he did before?
Yahweh says he now plans to do good to Jerusalem and the house of Judah.
uuz0
How does Yahweh command the people to behave and why?

Yahweh said the people must all speak truth with their neighbors, and judge in their gates with faithfulness and a peaceful judgment. He said no one may plan evil in his heart against his neighbor, nor love a false oath—Yahweh commanded these things because he hates them.
fyjz

In light of the fact that the fasts of the fourth, fifth, seventh and tenth months were going to be times of joy, gladness and happy festivals for the house of Judah, what were they told to do by Yahweh?
They were told to love faithfulness and peace.
ly5h
Who did Yahweh say would come to seek him and beg his favor?
Yahweh said many people from many different cities and mighty nations would come to seek Yahweh and beg his favor.
qx8r
In those days, why will ten men from every language and nation ask to go up to Jerusalem with Yahweh’s people?
They will grab the robe of a man of Judah and ask to go with him because they will have heard that God is with him.
m4vl
What does Yahweh’s declaration concern?
Yahweh’s declaration concerns the land of Hadrach and Damascus, Hamath, and Tyre and Sidon.
hlg1
What has Tyre done with silver and gold?
Tyre has heaped up silver like dust and refined gold like the mud of the streets.
vnm2
What does Yahweh say the Lord will do to Tyre?
Yahweh says that the Lord will dispossess her and strike down her wealth on the sea, so she will be devoured by fire.
xij1
What will happen to the king of Gaza and to Ashkelon?
The king will perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon will not be inhabited.
uu2i
What did Yahweh say he would do to the Philistines, and what would become of them?
Yahweh said he would cut off the pride of the Philistines. Yahweh also said they would become a remnant for God, like a clan in Judah.
yyba
What is one reason Yahweh gives for camping around his house?
Yahweh said he would camp around his house against enemy armies so no one could pass through or return, for he said that no oppressor would pass through it any more.
yvwy
Why is the daughter of Zion told to shout with great joy and the daughter of Jerusalem told to shout with happiness?
They are told to do this because their king is coming to them with righteousness and is going to rescue them.
fp5q
How will their king come to them?
Their king will be humble and will ride on a donkey, on the colt of a donkey.
fh96
What will this king speak to the nations?
That king will speak peace to the nations.
zic3
What will be the extent of that king’s dominion?
That king’s dominion will be from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the earth.
hyk5
Why has Yahweh set free their prisoners from the pit where there is no water?
Yahweh says he has done this because of the blood of his covenant with them.
ngiw
What does Yahweh declare he will do for the prisoners of hope?
Yahweh declares that he will return double to them.
qcrr
Against whom will Yahweh rouse the sons of Zion?
Yahweh will rouse the sons of Zion against the sons of Greece.
fbw1
What will Yahweh make Zion like?
Yahweh will make Zion like the sword of a mighty man.
ocj6
What will Yahweh do when he appears over his people?
Yahweh’s arrow will go out like lightning, and he will blow the trumpet and go with the storms of the south.
hgv6
What will Yahweh do for his people?
Yahweh will protect his people, and they will defeat the enemies who attack them with slingstones.
oryd
What will Zion be on that day when Yahweh, their God, rescues them?
On that day, Zion will be the jewels of a crown raised up over Yahweh’s land.
h6oq
What will make the young men and young women strong?
The young men will grow strong from grain, and the young women will grow strong from new wine.
acur
What will Yahweh do when people ask him for rain?
Yahweh will give them rain showers, and he will make plants grow in the field.
j3l1
What causes the people to wander like sheep and suffer?
The people wander like sheep and suffer because the household idols speak falsely, the diviners envision a lie, they tell empty dreams, and they give empty comfort. The people also have no shepherd.
zs12
Who does Yahweh say he will punish?
Yahweh says he will punish the leaders, whom he calls the male goats.
ihag
What does Yahweh say will come from the house of Judah?
Yahweh says the cornerstone, the tent peg, the battle bow, and every ruler will come from the house of Judah.
bdbj
What will the people’s warriors do because Yahweh is with them?
They will fight like warriors trampling their enemies in the mud of the streets, and they will defeat the horsemen because Yahweh is with them.
bd9g
What did Yahweh say he would do for the house of Judah and the house of Joseph?
Yahweh said he would strengthen the house of Judah, save the house of Joseph, bring them back, and have compassion on them.
uv69
How will the people of Ephraim feel because of what Yahweh has done?
The people of Ephraim will be glad like warriors who have drunk wine, and their children will see it and rejoice in Yahweh.
fv4t
What will Yahweh do because he has redeemed his people?
Yahweh will whistle for his people and gather them together, and they will become as many as they were before.
oljg
What will Judah and Ephraim do when they remember Yahweh in the distant countries where Yahweh has scattered them?
They and their children will live and return when they remember Yahweh in the distant countries where he has scattered them.
ve4j
Where will Yahweh gather his people from, and where will he bring them?
Yahweh will gather his people from Egypt and Assyria, and he will bring them to the land of Gilead and Lebanon, where there will not be enough room for them.
seoo
What did Yahweh say he would do to Assyria and Egypt?
Yahweh said he would bring down the pride of Assyria and take away the scepter of Egypt.
cdtt
How will the people live after Yahweh strengthens them?
The people will live faithfully, honoring Yahweh’s name.
hkjt
What is Lebanon told to do?
Lebanon is told to open its doors so that fire can burn up its cedar trees.
cuyt
What does the fall of the cedar trees cause the cypress trees to do?
It causes the cypress trees to wail.
jgdz
Why are the shepherds crying?
The shepherds are crying because their pastures have been destroyed.
bnph
What did Yahweh tell Zechariah to do?
Yahweh told Zechariah to shepherd the flock that was intended for slaughter.
c89j
What do the sellers of the sheep say?
The sellers say they praise Yahweh because they are becoming rich.
xlaj
What did Yahweh say he would do to the inhabitants of the land?
Yahweh said he would no longer pity them, but would let each man’s neighbor and king dominate him, and they would destroy the land, and he would not rescue them.
x38p
What were the names of the two staffs that Zechariah used to shepherd the flock meant for slaughter?
The names of the two staffs were “Favor” and “Union.”
mov6
Why did Zechariah destroy three shepherds in one month?
Zechariah did this because he became impatient with the shepherds, and they also hated him.
vi5t
What did Zechariah say he would no longer do?
Zechariah said he would no longer be their shepherd.
ad34
Why did Zechariah break his staff, “Favor?”
He broke it to break the covenant that he had made with all the peoples.
wgop
What did the poor of the flock who were watching Zechariah know?
They knew that it was the word of Yahweh.
gluo
How much was Zechariah paid?
Zechariah was paid thirty pieces of silver.
nlba
What did Yahweh tell Zechariah to do with his thirty pieces of silver?
Yahweh told him to throw it to the potter at the house of Yahweh.
l3sr
What did breaking the second staff, Union, do?
Breaking the second staff broke the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.
w57j
What did Yahweh tell Zechariah to take again?
Yahweh told him to take the tools of a foolish shepherd.
xjbi
Yahweh said he would raise up a shepherd in the land. What will that shepherd do?

That shepherd will not care for the sheep. He will not help the sheep that are perishing, he will not search for the ones that have strayed, and he will not heal the ones that are injured. He will not feed the healthy sheep, but will eat the fattest sheep and tear off their hooves.
ausn
What curse is pronounced upon the worthless shepherd who forsakes the flock?
The curse says that a sword will strike the shepherd’s arm and his right eye, and that his arm will wither and his right eye will become blind.
zcjz
Who is Yahweh who makes this declaration concerning Israel?
Yahweh is the one who stretches out the heavens, lays the foundation of the earth, and forms the spirit of man within him.
yxg9
What does Yahweh say he will make Jerusalem like for all the surrounding peoples?
Yahweh says he will make Jerusalem like a strong drink that makes all the surrounding peoples stagger.
j0nc
Who is going to gather against Jerusalem?
All the nations of the earth are going to gather against Jerusalem.
czny
On the day when all the nations gather against Judah, what specific things did Yahweh say he would do to the horses and riders of the enemy armies?
Yahweh said he would strike every horse with confusion and each rider with madness. Yahweh also said he would strike every horse of the enemy nations with blindness.
pk1b
What will the leaders of Judah say about the people of Jerusalem?
The leaders of Judah will say that the people of Jerusalem are a strength to them through Yahweh of Armies, their God.
lx80
In that day, what will the leaders of Judah be like?
In that day, the leaders of Judah will be like a basin of fire among trees and like a torch of fire in a sheaf.
h3m1
Why will Yahweh save the tents of Judah first?
Yahweh will save the tents of Judah first so that the honor of the house of David and the honor of those who live in Jerusalem may not be greater than the rest of Judah.
xxw5
What did Yahweh say he will do for the people of Jerusalem on that day?
Yahweh said he will defend the people of Jerusalem, and even the weakest among them will become as strong as David.
t4bq
What is Yahweh determined to do on that day?
Yahweh said that on that day he is determined to destroy all the nations who come against Jerusalem.
bxsd
On that day, what will Yahweh pour out on the house of David and the inhabitants of Jerusalem?
Yahweh will pour out a spirit of favor and supplications.
fgp7
What will the house of David and the inhabitants of Jerusalem do when they look upon him whom they have pierced?
When they look on him whom they have pierced, they will lament and mourn for him as one mourns and laments for an only son or over the death of a firstborn son.
ki9v
What will the mourning in Jerusalem be like on that day?
The mourning in Jerusalem will be great, like the mourning of Hadad Rimmon in the plain of Megiddo.
n6zf
How will the land mourn in that day?
The land will mourn by clans: each clan will mourn separately, and within each clan, the men and their wives will mourn separately from each other.
fjvz
For what will the fountain be that is opened for the house of David on that day?
The fountain will be for their sin and impurity.
zpv8
What will Yahweh cut off from the land and why?
Yahweh will cut off the names of idols from the land so they will no longer be remembered.
arab
What will Yahweh cause to pass out of the land?
Yahweh will cause the false prophets and their unclean spirits to pass out of the land.
feft
If any man continues to prophesy, what will his father and mother do to him?
His father and mother who bore him will pierce him when he prophesies.
eym6
In that day, why will he who prophesies no longer wear a hairy cloak?
He will no longer wear a hairy cloak because he will no longer try to deceive people.
zx4q
What will the man say about himself instead of admitting he is a prophet?
He will say that he is not a prophet, but works the land for a man who owned him since he was young.
km2r
When someone asks about the wounds on his chest, what will the man say?
He will say that someone wounded him at the house of his friends.
hb24
Who is the shepherd?
The shepherd is the man who is Yahweh’s close companion.
w1ey
What will happen to the flock when the shepherd is killed?
When the shepherd is killed, the flock will scatter.
